text.tspan: KawaGiif frontend (src/): React draws and asks, Rust owns the state
Two window classes, one Vite entry each. Everything that crosses to Rust goes through lib/ipc.ts.
Overlay windows (x N pool slots OV-SLOT-n)
browser-only mode: MOCK_RESPONSES when Tauri is absent
useEditorSync overlay moved / selection -> editor state
#[tauri::command] handlers, EditorState / LibraryState / SysState, emit / emit_to
events: Rust -> React (emit = all windows, emit_to = one window)
